Image 4 has 3 dice, the values of their TOP faces are 1, 4, 4, sum = 9. 
Image 5 has 3 dice, the values of their TOP faces are 6, 6, 4, sum = 16. 
Image 6 has 3 dice, the values of their TOP faces are 6, 4, 7, sum = 17.
